prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1135; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash injury. The mechanism of injury described is a plausible cause of the reported symptoms. Over the course of care, the patient attended 21 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of injury. Physical examination revealed limited cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, supporting the diagnosis, while neurological screening and imaging were within normal limits. Review of prior records notes a minor cervical strain several years ago that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records were reviewed and do not show duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Treatment included chiropractic adjustments, soft tissue therapy, and a home exercise program. At the time of the most recent visit, the patient reported partial improvement, with ongoing intermittent stiffness and reduced tolerance for prolonged neck positioning. Further follow-up is recommended to monitor progress and reassess functional status.
